KHINDIVI label expansion Prior Approval Supplement (PAS) accepted for review and assigned May 28, 2027 PDUFA date.
An NDA with a March 29, 2027, PDUFA date is currently under FDA review and if approved, would add ages 6 to 11 to the product’s label.
The Company is on track to submit an NDA near the end of 2026 or early 2027, allowing for potential approval and launch in 2027.
